name: Hand of Iruxos
summary: Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village says the Burning Blade holds a Demon Box, and that something powerful called the Hand of Iruxos is kept inside. At Mannoroc Coven, the Burning Blade makes use of it to open demon portals. Taiga sends you to Thunder Axe Fortress to fetch the box.

sections.title: The Box in the Fortress
sections.body: Taiga Wisemane wants the flow of demons into our world stopped. You are given a demon pick, to be used on the red crystal inside Thunder Axe Fortress, which opens the way to the Demon Box. The box and the pick are to be brought back to Taiga in Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: Who asks for the Demon Box?
What is the Hand of Iruxos?
faq.answer: Something powerful that lies inside the Demon Box. At Mannoroc Coven, the Burning Blade makes use of it to open portals for demons.
In Thunder Axe Fortress, where a red crystal gives access to it.

faq.q: How do you get to the Demon Box?
faq.answer: You are given a demon pick, and you use it on the red crystal inside Thunder Axe Fortress.
